articles.title: Amazon, Flipkart see strong start to 2026 festive sales
articles.text:
Amazon, Flipkart see strong start to 2026 festive sales
Both ecommerce platforms reported record day-one activity, driven by shoppers in non-metro markets. Amazon recorded a 100% year-on-year increase in products ordered, while Flipkart reported peak traffic of 6.3 million concurrent users per minute.
India’s two largest ecommerce platforms, Amazon India and Flipkart, have launched their flagship annual festive sales—the Amazon Great Indian Festival (GIF) 2026 and Flipkart’s The Big Billion Days (TBBD) 2026. Both platforms reported strong consumer participation, sharp increase in demand across categories, and growing adoption of quick-commerce delivery options in non-metro markets.
Scale, traffic, and reach
Amazon said it recorded over 440 million visits during the opening phase of its sale, the highest volume in its history. The platform saw a 100% year-on-year increase in products ordered, while daily app downloads surged fivefold. More than 72% of visits came from outside the top nine metros. First-time shoppers nearly doubled year-on-year, and orders were placed from every pin code in the country.
Flipkart, meanwhile, recorded 6.3 million concurrent users per minute during its opening peak hour, attracting over six times as many active users as during a regular hour. The platform said it also recorded 287 million sessions during the early access window for Plus, Black, and co-branded card members.
Non-metro markets accounted for approximately 60% of overall traction, with Tier III towns and beyond contributing nearly half of all visits during the opening hour, it said. New customer numbers grew 34% during the same period.
Category drivers and shopping trends
Amazon said electronics and premium upgrades performed exceptionally well. Premium Android smartphone sales rose 70% year-on-year, while MacBook Neo sales grew 65X over a regular business day. Large appliances surged 50X, led by washing machines (80X), refrigerators (60X), and home entertainment (77X).
In fashion, footwear sales reached seven pairs per second, while Nike sales rose 16-fold compared with regular days. Denim sales exceeded 1,500 pairs per hour, while premium beauty products sold at a rate of 150 units per minute.
Flipkart said it saw strong demand in Large Appliances, which grew 30% year-on-year in the first hour, alongside a 73% year-on-year jump in tablets. Beauty sales on Flipkart grew 42% overall and 48% among Gen Z shoppers, heavily propelled by men's grooming. At peak, Flipkart said it processed over 1,600 units of men's perfume every minute. On the engagement side, over 12.7 million users accessed Flipkart’s live commerce and video shopping experiences, while 64% of Voice Search users came from Tier II plus markets.
Quick commerce and digital payment adoption
Rapid fulfillment became a central battleground across both marketplaces. Amazon said it fulfilled orders within minutes across more than 120 cities served by Amazon Now. Flipkart Minutes saw order volumes rise 3.5X over normal days and new customers jump 11X in the first hour, highlighted by a record delivery of an iPhone 17 to a customer in New Delhi in 3.4 minutes.
Affordability levers drove high-ticket conversion across both platforms. Half of Amazon’s buyers utilised EMI options, while Amazon Pay Later saw transactions double and its user base expand by 80% year-on-year. Flipkart similarly reported that one in three mobile buyers opted for No Cost EMI, while one in four utilized product exchange offers.
Merchant ecosystem and brand traction
Seller participation expanded across both platforms. Amazon said sellers recorded over 2X units ordered in the first 24 hours compared to last year, with sellers generating over Rs 1 crore in sales growing by more than 80%. Category growth for sellers was led by beauty (7X), kitchen (4.2X), and wireless (3.4X).
Some of the key partner brands reported significant surges such as Philips (10X over daily baseline), Reebok (doubled sales YoY), WROGN (10X over daily baseline), and Penguin Random House India (up nearly 50% YoY).
Flipkart said reported that 51% of transacting sellers doubled their standard daily business during Early Access. Sellers based in Tier II plus regions such as small businesses and MSMEs achieved a 2.9X growth, with manufacturing and seller hubs such as Bhiwandi, Panipat, Tirupur, and Hisar leading the sales momentum.

articles.title: El sube y baja de ethereum: cuál es su costo este 9 de octubre
articles.text:
Ether, comúnmente llamada como ethereum, es la moneda virtual #2 en cuanto a términos de capitalización de mercado, por lo que se trata de una de las divisas digitales que más despierta el interés entre los mineros (creadores de las criptodivisas).
Ethereum es una plataforma de blockchain de código abierto que se ejecuta con el uso de su moneda nativa, llamada ether o ETH, por lo que a pesar de que la gente usa estos nombres como sinónimos son cosas distintas.
Ether es un token que se utiliza específicamente en la blockchain ethereum para pagar transacciones. Este token es responsable de impulsar casi todo lo que ocurre en la red, misma que puede ser usada por cualquier persona para crear y ejecutar contratos inteligentes, que son programas de software que se ejecutan de manera autónoma y sin la intervención del usuario.
De acuerdo con el portal de Binance, la moneda digital solana actualmente cuenta con 122.1M de unidades creadas.
Mientras el debate se acalora cada día más sobre la conveniencia o no de su uso, ethereum cotiza este día a las 14:05 horas (UTC) en 2482.68 dólares, lo que supone un cambio de -1.5 % con respecto a las últimas 24 horas y una variación de 0.0 % con referencia a su valor alcanzado en la última hora.
En cuanto a su popularidad de mercado, ha mantenido el puesto #2 entre las monedas digitales.
Cotización de la criptomoneda Ethereum
La nueva era de Ether
Tras varios meses de retraso y con el temor de que ya nunca pasaría, finalmente el 15 de septiembre de 2022 Ethereum llevó a cabo su tan ansiada fusión o actualización al nuevo nivel 2.0 con la promesa de mejorar la experiencia de los usuarios de esta criptomoneda.
“The Merge”, inglés para “La Fusión”, es una transformación en la forma en que Ethereum procesa las transacciones y en cómo se crean nuevos tokens de Ether.
Esta fusión se trata de la combinación de la cadena de bloques de Ethereum con una nueva cadena de bloques separada conocido como proof-of-stake, el cual reduce el consumo de energía de la cadena de bloques de Ethereum en un 99,9 %, según sus propios desarrolladores, lo que la vuelve más “amigable” con el ambiente al tiempo que las transacciones serían más baratas.
Sus defensores creen que la fusión hará que Ethereum resulte favorecido con respecto al máximo rival, Bitcoin, pues podría aumentar su uso.
En el proceso Proof Stake los propietarios de Ether bloquearán cantidades establecidas de sus criptomonedas para verificar nuevos registros en la cadena de bloques, ganando nuevas monedas además de su criptografía “participada”.

articles.title: Actualización a One UI 9 para los Samsung Galaxy: cuáles están ya actualizados y todos los que van a actualizar
articles.text:
Los dueños de un Samsung Galaxy estamos con los ojos puestos en el menú de actualización del teléfono: Android 17 está llegando bajo la capa One UI 9. Los móviles plegables más recientes salieron todos con esta versión, el resto del catálogo está esperando su llegada una vez el despliegue se ha iniciado en el país de origen de Samsung.
Móviles ya actualizados. La distribución inicial de la nueva versión ya ha alcanzado a los terminales plegables más recientes de la marca, tanto los que Samsung presentó este año como los de la familia de 2025. Estos son:
En la categoría de teléfonos "normales", One UI 9 está listo para toda la familia Galaxy S26, los S25 y algunas tablets contemporáneas:
- Samsung Galaxy S26.
- Samsung Galaxy S26+.
- Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra.
- Samsung Galaxy S26 FE.
- Samsung Galaxy S25.
- Samsung Galaxy S25+.
- Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra.
- Samsung Galaxy S25 FE.
- Samsung Galaxy S25 Edge.
- Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra.
- Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+.
Próximos móviles que se actualizarán. Samsung confirmó el inicio de la gran actualización en Corea del Sur y anunció que iría llegando a más dispositivos. Sin haber aún confirmación oficial, se prevé que One UI 9 llegue en las próximas semanas a los siguientes plegables:
Ese mismo calendario previsible contempla la actualización de la serie Galaxy S24 al completo, incluidos los modelos FE. En la gama media, los Galaxy A57 y Galaxy A37 también tienen prevista su actualización en esa misma franja:
- Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra.
- Samsung Galaxy S24+.
- Samsung Galaxy S24.
- Samsung Galaxy S24 FE.
- Samsung Galaxy A57.
- Samsung Galaxy A37.
Previsiones para el resto del catálogo. Los modelos lanzados en 2023, y alguno previo, podrían situarse a continuación si la compañía mantiene su pauta habitual. Noviembre se perfila como futurible para los siguientes dispositivos:
- Samsung Galaxy Z Fold5.
- Samsung Galaxy Z Flip5.
- Samsung Galaxy S23.
- Samsung Galaxy S23+.
- Samsung Galaxy S23 Ultra.
- Samsung Galaxy S23 FE.
- Samsung Galaxy A56.
- Samsung Galaxy A36.
Otros teléfonos de la serie A recibirán previsiblemente el sistema entre finales de octubre, noviembre o diciembre. La previsión incluye los siguientes modelos:
- Samsung Galaxy A55.
- Samsung Galaxy A54.
- Samsung Galaxy A35.
- Samsung Galaxy A34.
- Samsung Galaxy A26.
- Samsung Galaxy A25.
- Samsung Galaxy A17.
- Samsung Galaxy A16.
- Samsung Galaxy A15.
- Samsung Galaxy A07.
- Samsung Galaxy A06 5G.
- Samsung Galaxy XCover7.
- Samsung Galaxy XCover7 Pro.
En cuanto a las tablets pendientes, la lista abarca las gamas Galaxy Tab S11 y Tab S10, además de las variantes FE. También deberían de recibir la actualización las familias Galaxy Tab S9 y Tab S8 al completo, las Galaxy Tab A11 y la Galaxy Tab Active5:
- Samsung Galaxy Tab S11.
- Samsung Galaxy Tab S11 Ultra.
- Samsung Galaxy Tab S10+.
- Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 Ultra.
- Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 FE.
- Samsung Galaxy Tab S10 FE+.
- Samsung Galaxy Tab S9.
- Samsung Galaxy Tab S9+.
- Samsung Galaxy Tab S9 Ultra.
- Samsung Galaxy Tab S9 FE.
- Samsung Galaxy Tab S9 FE+.
- Samsung Galaxy Tab A11.
- Samsung Galaxy Tab A11+.
- Samsung Galaxy Tab Active5.
Dispositivos sin soporte para One UI 9. La parte más antigua del catálogo se quedaría fuera de One UI 9 al haberse agotado sus cuatro años de soporte en lugar de los siete años que Samsung ofrece en sus gamas altas más recientes. Ahí entrarían:
- Samsung Galaxy S22.
- Samsung Galaxy S22+.
- Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra.
- Samsung Galaxy S21 FE.
- Samsung Galaxy Z Fold4.
- Samsung Galaxy Z Flip4.
- Samsung Galaxy A73.
- Samsung Galaxy A53.
Cómo buscar la actualización. Para verificar si la descarga ya se encuentra disponible, basta con acceder al menú de ajustes del teléfono o tablet. Dentro de ese menú se encuentra la sección destinada a la actualización de software. Basta con pulsar ahí y buscar nuevas versiones del sistema. Si hay suerte, el móvil se encargará de actualizarse y de reiniciar.
Novedades de One UI 9. La actualización amplía las herramientas de Galaxy AI con funciones como Now Nudge y Now Brief. Las sugerencias de Now se integran ahora en el teclado, en las notificaciones de mensajes y mediante un botón flotante, abarcando reservas, direcciones y ubicaciones de Google Maps.
El apartado de vídeo añade My FanCam, una opción que permite elegir una persona en un vídeo grabado y mantenerla centrada mediante un reencuadre automático. Además, la función de intérprete con IA permite consultar la conversación mientras se habla y la pantalla de llamada muestra datos contextuales en tiempo real.
Ajustes y personalización. El panel rápido permite redistribuir controles, redimensionar los deslizadores de brillo o volumen y separar el modo de sonido. En seguridad, One UI 9 añade el menú Garantía y cuidado, un bloqueo rápido que desactiva los datos biométricos, avisos sobre permisos innecesarios y el nuevo indicador azul de acceso a la ubicación.
La aplicación de salud de Samsung estrena rediseño y paneles personalizables en su pantalla de inicio. También añade registro rápido con cámara, seguimiento de carga cardiovascular, índice de condición física general, análisis del sueño, control auditivo para auriculares y la monitorización de tendencias del ritmo corporal en el calendario.
Otras novedades menores son la activación de Bixby al acercar el teléfono a la boca, mejoras en Samsung DeX con vistas previas de escritorio, un reloj renovado para la pantalla de bloqueo y diversas funciones de accesibilidad. Como la lectura Select and Speak y atajos para teclado físico.

articles.title: Nous avons testé la balance Withings BodyFit et sa poignée de mesure, notre verdict
articles.text:
| Alimentation | Batterie | 
| Compatibilité | Android et iOS | 
| Wi-Fi | Oui | 
| Bluetooth | Oui | 
| Affichage | Ecran LCD couleur | 
| Dimensions (H x L x P) | 325 x 325 x 25,6 mm | 
| Poids | 2 kg | 
| Masse maximale | 200 kg | 
Avec sa poignée rétractable et huit électrodes, la Withings BodyFit promet de détailler notre composition corporelle, zone par zone. Nous avons évalué ses mesures, son confort d'utilisation et le suivi proposé dans l'application.
La Withings BodyFit reprend la formule des balances à poignée pour proposer un suivi plus détaillé que la seule évolution du poids. Quatre électrodes sont intégrées au plateau et quatre autres à la poignée rétractable. Celles-ci servent à estimer la composition corporelle par bio-impédance et à distinguer la répartition des graisses et muscles dans différentes zones du corps.
Le fabricant indique avoir intégré plus de 40 indicateurs, dont la masse grasse, la masse musculaire, l'eau corporelle, la masse osseuse, la graisse viscérale ou le métabolisme de base. La BodyFit relève aussi la fréquence cardiaque et estime l'âge vasculaire, mais ne réalise toutefois pas d'ECG.
Lancée à 250 €, la Withings BodyFit permet de consulter toutes les mesures dans son application, sans frais supplémentaires. L'abonnement facultatif à Withings+ ajoute néanmoins des fonctions d'accompagnement. L'appareil assure une pesée sur une plage de 5 à 200 kg avec une graduation de 50 g.
La BodyFit arbore une silhouette assez classique avec un plateau carré de 32,5 cm de côté et une hauteur de 2,56 cm. La poignée rangée sur le bord supérieur indique toutefois que cette balance en fait bien plus. La fabrication est soignée et l'ensemble se montre agréable à regarder, du moins avant les premières utilisations. Las, le verre sombre retient vite la poussière et les traces de contact.
Les accessoires se limitent à un câble USB-C et quatre pieds supplémentaires destinés aux sols textiles, comme une moquette, qui ne doivent pas être ajoutés sur du carrelage. La batterie se recharge en USB-C, Withings annonçant jusqu'à un an d'autonomie. Cela dépendra évidemment de la fréquence de pesées et du nombre d'utilisateurs.
La configuration passe par l'app Withings sur smartphone. Après l'association Bluetooth, on peut connecter la balance au réseau wifi domestique. Un vrai confort au quotidien, car les mesures sont synchronisées sans avoir besoin de garder son téléphone à proximité ou d'ouvrir l'application à chaque pesée.
L'app Withings explique aussi la posture à adopter. Il faut monter, toujours pieds nus, saisir la poignée à deux mains dans le bon sens et rester immobile. Les bras doivent être légèrement écartés du torse, tout comme les cuisses entre elles, pour éviter les contacts peau contre peau.
Le câble se déroule lorsqu'on soulève la poignée, puis se rétracte une fois l'analyse terminée.
Jusqu'à huit utilisateurs peuvent partager l'appareil. La reconnaissance est automatique et, si nécessaire, le choix du profil s'effectue en basculant le poids d'un pied sur l'autre. Notez qu'il n'est pas obligatoire de prendre la poignée pour une simple pesée ou une mesure d'âge vasculaire.
L'écran couleur d'environ 3,4 pouces affiche clairement le poids et les données suivantes. On choisit dans l'application les informations à faire défiler : tendances pondérales, graisse, muscles, eau ou encore fréquence cardiaque. Chacun peut ainsi adapter sa séquence sans modifier celle des autres utilisateurs. Les données détaillées restent dans tous les cas consultables sur le téléphone.
Lors de nos tests, la BodyFit s'est montrée précise, bien qu'elle accuse de légères variations. En enchaînant cinq pesées successives, nous avons constaté un écart maximal de 200 g. À l'échelle d'un adulte, cette marge d'erreur reste tout à fait négligeable.
Par ailleurs, la balance détecte parfaitement les petites charges : si vous montez dessus avec 100 ou 200 g supplémentaires, elle les repère immédiatement. Il faut simplement garder à l'esprit que sa graduation affichée de 50 g ne garantit pas que les résultats se répéteront systématiquement à 50 g près.
Le constat est similaire du côté des estimations de la composition corporelle. Sur cinq analyses réalisées à quelques minutes d'intervalle, la proportion de masse grasse a légèrement oscillé (entre 15,4 et 15,9 %), tout comme la masse musculaire (79,9 à 80,3 %). Puisqu'il est évidemment impossible de prendre du muscle en 2 min, ces petits écarts sont purement techniques. Plus que la précision absolue, ces mesures permettent surtout d'observer une tendance sur plusieurs semaines, et non d'interpréter chaque dixième de point d'un jour sur l'autre.
L'application Withings est bien organisée, quoique fournie. L'accueil résume les dernières mesures et leur évolution, puis chaque indicateur peut être exploré plus en détail. Les courbes permettent de consulter le suivi au fil des jours, mois ou année, avec des chiffres et explications pour accompagner la lecture.
L'analyse segmentaire est proposée sous forme de chiffres ou grâce à une aide visuelle. Un schéma du corps montre ainsi la répartition des graisses et des muscles dans les bras, les jambes et le torse, tandis que la graisse viscérale dispose de son propre indice. On comprend ainsi plus facilement où se répartissent les masses qu'en parcourant une succession de pourcentages. L'app situe aussi certains résultats par rapport à ceux d'utilisateurs du même âge et du même IMC.
Si l'on possède d'autres appareils Withings, nul besoin de jongler entre les onglets. Les données d'une montre ou d'un thermomètre de la marque rejoignent la même interface, sans multiplier les applications. Une fonction permet aussi de partager ses informations de santé avec un proche ou un médecin.
Les mesures, leur historique et la composition corporelle segmentaire sont accessibles gratuitement. En revanche, l'accompagnement complet passe par Withings+. BodyPath propose notamment un suivi des objectifs et du bilan calorique avec des analyses et recommandations personnalisées. L'offre annuelle pour ce service est proposée à 99,50 €.
La Withings BodyFit propose un suivi détaillé de la composition corporelle dans un appareil bien fini et simple à utiliser. Sa connexion wifi facilite l'enregistrement des pesées sans smartphone à proximité, tandis que l'application présente clairement l'évolution des mesures et la répartition des graisses et des muscles. Les légères variations observées entre plusieurs analyses invitent à privilégier l'observation des tendances. On regrette une surface sensible aux traces et un abonnement nécessaire pour profiter de tout l'accompagnement. Les mesures et leur historique restent néanmoins accessibles gratuitement, ce qui permet déjà d'aller bien au-delà du simple suivi du poids.
La Withings Body Scan ajoute à l'analyse segmentaire des fonctions de santé plus poussées, notamment un ECG, tout en conservant la synchronisation wifi et le suivi dans l'app Withings. La Renpho Morphoscan, au prix plus abordable, propose également une analyse par zone avec une application entièrement gratuite, mais sa connexion exclusivement Bluetooth impose de garder le smartphone à proximité et d'ouvrir l'app pour enregistrer les pesées.

articles.title: Richard Garriott says he's getting the Ultima rights back from EA in 2027
articles.text:
True Classics: Richard Garriott recently confirmed that he will soon reacquire the IP rights to the Ultima series from EA. The distinguished game designer and the publisher have already exchanged a few emails about the matter, so things could soon start moving again for one of the most iconic CRPG series of all time.
Richard Garriott will soon get the Ultima rights back and is already planning what to do with the series afterward. The British-born American game designer, entrepreneur, and space tourist played a major role in establishing the CRPG genre during the home computer era. Now, the man behind the Lord British persona wants another go at the popular series, which debuted almost half a century ago.
Garriott recently reiterated what he believes will happen a year from now. Thanks to a "really weird" US copyright law, the original rights holder can essentially reclaim their intellectual property 35 years after selling it to someone else. The process does not require any payment; the original owner simply needs to notify the current rights holder a year before reclaiming the IP.
Lord British contacted EA, the most recent holder of the Ultima rights, in April this year. As he explained in the interview, the publisher acknowledged his request and confirmed that it would act in accordance with US copyright law.
As things stand, Garriott will officially regain ownership of the Ultima series in 2027. The designer is spending this year considering his next move, as the Ultima brand might still carry some weight among CRPG fans. Lord British could eventually re-release the earlier Ultima games on modern platforms or launch an entirely new Ultima experience. He is even considering working with EA again to secure the franchise's future in gaming.
"The point is – I have control again of the future of my seminal product line," Garriott said in the interview.
Richard Garriott sold Origin Systems, along with the Ultima series, to Electronic Arts in 1992. Ultima IX, the last mainline entry in the series, came out in 1999. Subsequent attempts to revive the franchise, such as the free-to-play Ultima Forever: Quest for the Avatar in 2013, failed to gain enough traction among gamers.
Throughout the 80s and early 90s, Ultima helped introduce new conventions and mechanics to computer role-playing games. Alongside Wizardry, Might and Magic, and a few other influential franchises, the series established standards and pioneered innovations that many successful games later adopted. To this day, fans continue to build new projects and remakes using the creative DNA of the original Ultima games.

articles.title: A Cray-1 supercomputer replica from 30 "obsolete" Mac Minis
articles.text:
The Museo de Historia de la Computación in Spain has unveiled a 1:1 scale visual replica of the famous Cray-1 supercomputer from 1976. Instead of sourcing expensive, cutting-edge tech to run the system, the creative team powered the project with 30 2012-era Mac Minis. Developed over 18 months, the project serves as a 50th-anniversary tribute to the Cray-1 and Apple’s founding.
Mac Minis from over a decade ago might not seem like the obvious first choice for building a cluster supercomputer, but when networked together, the developers can orchestrate the 64 active processing cores into a combined 1.3 teraflops of performance in their most recent tests. The museum reportedly achieved 1.5 teraflops previously using all 70 available cores, prior to one node going offline. Benchmarks were obtained using a custom matrix-multiplication Python script. Five PCs are quad-core i7s, and the remaining 25 are dual-core i5 models. Except for two units from 2014, the rest of the array dates to 2012.
The replica is a valuable tool for museum-goers to understand the shifts in computer architecture since 1976. The original Cray-1 used vector processing, applying a single instruction to multiple data elements simultaneously, whereas the replica distributes work across independent processors in a parallel cluster. The peak theoretical performance of the original Cray-1 was approximately 160 megaflops. What was originally a purpose-built research machine has been re-created with consumer hardware that’s vastly more capable than the machine that inspired it.
Rather than opting for a more standard Linux distribution, the team found that macOS Mojave (10.14) met their project needs by harnessing macOS’s built-in support for MPI (Message Passing Interface), the software layer that allows all the nodes in the cluster to pass tasks to one another.
Guests at the Museo de Historia de la Computación can watch in real time as the system runs matrix algorithms, mapping the scale of system performance from a single core to the full suite running in parallel.
Stealth supercomputing
Combining 30 consumer PCs into an operational cluster wasn’t the only engineering challenge the team faced. If you’ve ever stepped inside a server room, or, like me, foolishly installed one in your own basement, you know that fan cooling can be loud. The museum team used passive convection cooling via a steel rack chassis and aluminum tray mounts for each Mac Mini. Compared to the roaring thunder of a modern data center, this cluster is nearly inaudible.

articles.title: Anthropic can't reliably control its AI agents. It's cutting off its internal evals from the live internet instead | TechCrunch
articles.text:
Anthropic said its models exploited websites on the internet, including some run by U.S. government agencies, and it will turn off live internet access for all of its internal evaluations until the frontier lab is sure it can monitor and control its AI agents.
The incidents, disclosed in a blog post, involved AI agents tasked to solve problems seeking resources on the internet. In the process, they exploited software flaws, accessed databases without paying fees, used URL shortening services to smuggle information past restrictions, and even submitted a false murder tip to the Philadelphia police.
Anthropic said it discovered these new issues in a review of its model’s activities that began in July, demonstrating the lab’s lack of awareness of its software’s behavior in real time.
Notably, the company said that alignment training was not yet sufficient for skills like search and computer use that are central to its pitch that AI agents will be used by any professional who relies on digital tools.
The behaviors Anthropic disclosed are similar to incidents involving OpenAI agents that collaborated to break into various websites in search of information, including some run by the Australian government.
Anthropic previously disclosed that its models had broken into external systems. The frontier lab said it considered today’s disclosures “significantly less severe from an alignment and security perspective” than those it announced before.
However, the lab still said it had “turned off live internet access” for “all our internal evaluations” until it is certain it can monitor and control its agents.
It’s not clear what that means. Sydney Von Arx, the founder of Nightingale, an AI safety organization, told TechCrunch in an interview before this disclosure that developing models on a data center cut off from the open internet would be very challenging for researchers, and hinder the progress of the models, which benefit from internet access.
“You have to align them at some point,” Von Arx said. “If the AIs are released to production and never have access to the internet, that’s not a very useful tool.”
Anthropic said the behavior was a result of flaws in the lab’s training environments, which led the models to believe they would be rewarded for finding loopholes or avoiding restrictions, a behavior called “reward hacking.”
The company said it would stop running some of its evaluations or move them offline, and has built tooling to detect and block this behavior. This tooling was tested against the kind of incidents disclosed today and blocked them; it’s not clear what evidence will prompt Anthropic to return live internet access to its internal evaluations. Anthropic also said it would migrate its internal AI agents to “centrally managed infrastructure with strong containment,” and is beginning to using safety classifiers more frequently to monitor those agents.
“It’s encouraging that Anthropic voluntarily disclosed more recent incidents, including where their agents targeted U.S. government websites,” Conrad Stosz, an official at AI oversight lab Transluce and former head of the US Center for AI Standards and Innovation, said in a statement. “But it just underscores the need for independent, credible, third-party verification of Al systems. Trust in this technology needs to be built through science-backed oversight and governance with meaningful access — not by relying on researchers to find these things in the wild or on companies to voluntarily disclose.”

articles.title: L'Espagne vient de durcir la règle du casque à vélo : la France va-t-elle suivre ?
articles.text:
Un cycliste adulte qui roule sans casque hors agglomération n’enfreint aucune règle nationale en France. En Espagne, c’est terminé depuis le 1er octobre : les dernières exemptions à l’obligation de casque ont disparu.
Une réforme pour les « usagers vulnérables »
Daté du 24 juin et entré en vigueur le 1er octobre, le décret royal 518/2026 réécrit une partie du code de la route espagnol. Selon la DGT, l’équivalent espagnol de la Sécurité routière, il définit pour la première fois les « usagers vulnérables » (piétons, cyclistes, utilisateurs de trottinettes, motards) afin de mieux les protéger. Cette catégorie pèse lourd puisqu’elle représentait 50,8 % des morts sur les routes espagnoles en 2024, d’après Motor16.
Hors agglomération, le casque est obligatoire pour tous les cyclistes, et les exemptions existantes sont supprimées. Elles couvraient jusqu’ici, selon la DGT, les longues montées, les raisons médicales et la chaleur extrême. Les professionnels à vélo, comme les livreurs, doivent en porter un en permanence, avec un gilet réfléchissant. Pour les trottinettes électriques, le casque est obligatoire et l’âge minimum est fixé à 15 ans. Sur route, l’automobiliste qui double un cycliste doit désormais ralentir d’au moins 20 km/h sous la limite, garder 1,5 mètre d’écart et, sur une route à plusieurs voies, se déporter complètement.
En ville, rien d’équivalent
En ville, le texte ne semble pas changer la règle pour les cyclistes adultes. Selon la DGT, le casque n’y est obligatoire que pour les moins de 16 ans et pour les professionnels, et seulement recommandé pour les autres. Le communiqué sur la réforme n’évoque aucune extension en zone urbaine : il insiste plutôt sur le fait de rouler au centre de la voie, et impose aux automobilistes de garder 5 mètres de distance avec un cycliste qui les précède dans la même voie. Les mairies, de leur côté, disposent d’une large marge pour appliquer les mesures urbaines.
À lire aussi : J’ai roulé 1500 km sur un vélo électrique chinois à 1000 euros : le verdict est sans appel
Et en France ?
La règle nationale est plus souple de ce côté-ci des Pyrénées. À vélo, le casque n’est obligatoire que pour les enfants de moins de 12 ans. Pour les trottinettes et autres engins motorisés, interdits aux moins de 14 ans, il l’est hors agglomération. Le gilet réfléchissant l’est lui aussi hors agglomération.
Cette règle est complétée par des arrêtés locaux. Depuis le 7 août, une nouvelle mesure impose le casque et un équipement rétro-réfléchissant aux utilisateurs de trottinettes électriques, gyropodes, monoroues et hoverboards à Paris, dans les Hauts-de-Seine, en Seine-Saint-Denis et dans le Val-de-Marne, à toute heure. Elle prévoit 135 euros d’amende sans casque et 35 euros sans équipement réfléchissant. Le dispositif existe déjà en Seine-et-Marne, dans les Alpes-Maritimes et dans l’Yonne, tandis que le Vaucluse n’exige que le casque.
C’est ce patchwork, parfois difficile à suivre, que Marie-Pierre Vedrenne, ministre déléguée auprès du ministre de l’Intérieur, voudrait simplifier. Selon son cabinet, qui s’est exprimé en août auprès de 20 Minutes, elle a demandé à la Sécurité routière d’étudier un casque obligatoire pour les trottinettes et les cyclistes « en toutes circonstances et sur l’ensemble du territoire ». À ce stade, rien n’est encore décidé et il faudrait un décret, pris après avis du Conseil d’État et une consultation du secteur.

articles.title: AnyPS5 project reaches critical GPU milestone in race to enable running PS5 games natively on PC — 100% shader instruction coverage is a massive step forward, but playing all PS5 games natively on PC is still far off
articles.text:
AnyPS5 project reaches critical GPU milestone in race to enable running PS5 games natively on PC — 100% shader instruction coverage is a massive step forward, but playing all PS5 games natively on PC is still far off
The new project is not an emulator, but an attempt to get PS5 games running natively on PC.
The open-source AnyPS5 project has reached 100% GPU shader instruction coverage, a significant milestone in its effort to run PlayStation 5 games natively on Windows and Linux PCs. The project's live progress tracker now lists all 1,166 instructions in its tracked AMD RDNA 1 and RDNA 2 instruction set as implemented. There's a fairly important asterisk attached to that number, though: it doesn't mean the PS5's GPU is fully supported, much less that PS5 games are ready to run on your PC.
The distinction is in how AnyPS5 defines "implemented." In this case, it means the project's shader decoder recognizes an instruction. That's an essential first step, but it doesn't necessarily mean every instruction is implemented in translation to SPIR-V, never mind a guarantee that the instruction's behavior is correct in every situation, that every GPU feature is supported, or that a game's shaders will render properly. Consider the network libraries: libSceHttp is reported at 95% implementation, but the technical-debt document explicitly states that no HTTP request reaches the network in the current implementation.
If you're confused about AnyPS5, let me break it down for you. The most accurate starting point is "native porting through binary transformation and API reimplementation," rather than conventional PS5 emulation. AnyPS5 takes an existing PS5 executable (in standard ELF format, like Linux) and relinks it into a native x86-64 Linux ELF or Windows PE executable. It doesn't need the game's original source code, and it doesn't rebuild the game from scratch; instead, it adapts the existing machine code and supplies native replacements for the PS5 system libraries the game expects to find.
The line gets blurrier when we reach the GPU. PS5 games use Sony's proprietary AGC graphics interface and AMD RDNA-specific shader instructions instead of the standard graphics APIs and shader formats familiar to PC developers. AnyPS5 reimplements the necessary graphics behavior and translates RDNA shader programs into SPIR-V for execution through Vulkan. That's translation, reimplementation, and arguably some emulation of hardware behavior at different levels, but it's not a conventional emulator recreating an entire virtual PS5 and running the game inside it. The CPU code can generally execute directly on a compatible x86-64 host, though AnyPS5 also provides a "--to-intel" option to convert supported AMD-only instructions for Intel processors.
There's plenty left to do beyond shader decoding. The project's tracker reports 84.69% implementation across 2,578 of the 3,044 system-library functions currently declared in its codebase. That figure doesn't represent every function in the PS5's firmware, nor does it guarantee that each implemented function behaves exactly as it does on the console. Graphics state, texture formats, synchronization, memory management, audio, and other system services must also work correctly for an entire game to run.
The project's official compatibility list currently identifies Dreaming Sarah, a charming but technically very simple 2D platformer, as its single verified playable title. Developers are making progress with more demanding games (including the recent Ghost of Yotei), but experimental bring-up reports still document substantial rendering, stability, and performance problems. Reaching a game's intro or rendering its first 3D scene is real progress; obviously, it isn't the same thing as playing through the game.
There's also no retail-disc-to-desktop shortcut here. AnyPS5's documented workflow starts with an already-extracted game ELF, its associated modules and resources, and a properly built set of host-side compatibility libraries. It isn't a disc-ripping or decryption tool, so you're going to have to figure out how to extract the game ELF and resources yourself.
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
Hardware requirements will vary by game, but memory headroom is a big concern: on Windows, the project warns that a title may request up to 13,824 MB (13.5 GB) of direct memory, with the full allocation charged against the system's commit limit immediately. That's not a universal free-RAM requirement, but it does mean that this isn't something to try on any old PC with 16GB of RAM and a small page file.
To be clear, none of this should be taken to mean I'm not gobsmacked by the achievement. Recognizing every instruction in the project's tracked RDNA list is a critical step toward broader compatibility, and the work now being done to translate those instructions and reproduce the surrounding GPU behavior is precisely what makes the project interesting. There's real work by humans going on here, too; the project counts over 100 human contributors besides the expected assistance from Claude (and potentially other assistants not credited directly on GitHub).
The more likely long-term outcome of AnyPS5 isn't a universal PS5 emulator where you insert a disc and press "play," but a powerful framework for unofficial native PC ports of individual games. There's a tricky legal tangle to work out there, though, and there's also still a tremendous amount of work between today's milestone and that future, but progress on the project is rapid. It may well be the case that we end up playing the PS5 version of GTA VI on PC before Rockstar drops an official PC release.

Zak is a freelance contributor to Tom's Hardware with decades of PC benchmarking experience who has also written for HotHardware and The Tech Report. A modern-day Renaissance man, he may not be an expert on anything, but he knows just a little about nearly everything.

articles.title: Chinese automaker Geely announces entry into Canadian market
articles.text:
Geely Auto has announced that it is officially entering the Canadian automotive market.
The Chinese automotive company says it will introduce its first vehicles to the Canadian market in 2027 and is currently establishing local operations and developing a retail network ahead of the launch.
“Canada represents an important next step in Geely Auto’s international growth,” said Bryan Wu, MD of Geely Auto Canada. “We are entering this market with a long-term commitment, bringing out global technology and engineering capabilities to Canadian drivers while building strong local partnerships and the support customers need to feel confident in choosing Geely.”
Wu also said that “We know that trust is earned over time, and we are committed to earning it here.”
The company says it enters Canada “backed by global capabilities in vehicle engineering, safety, electrification, intelligent technology and advanced manufacturing.” The Geely Auto Group sold more than 3.02 million vehicles globally, including almost 1.69 million “new energy” vehicles.
Geely is technically already doing business in Canada, but this will be the first time that the main brand will be sold here. The company currently owns Volvo, Lotus (which has already imported some of its Chinese-built EVs), and Polestar.

O kit inclui o tablet, a capa Folio e a caneta Tab Pen Plus, recarregável por uma porta USB-C e que oferece precisão ao escrever e desenhar. O uso produtivo é reforçado pelo Modo PC, que habilita uma interface de desktop melhor aproveitada com um teclado (não incluso).
O Idea Tab Pro Gen 2 possui uma câmera traseira de 13 MP, com autofoco e Flash, boa para digitalizar documentos e capaz de filmar em 4K. Já a frontal de 8 MP é adequada para videoconferências e grava vídeos em 1080p.
Sua bateria de 10.020 mAh resiste a até 14 horas de streaming de vídeo, conforme nosso review, e suporta carregamento de até 45 W via USB-C. Com o carregador de 20 W que acompanha o kit, ela foi de 0 a 100% em 2 horas e 26 minutos em nossos testes.
O Idea Tab Pro Gen 2 de 256 GB (R$ 3.449 em até 12x sem juros exclusivo Amazon Prime) roda Android 16 e deve receber mais duas atualizações do sistema operacional. O tablet da Lenovo possui conectividade Wi-Fi 7 e Bluetooth 6.0.

articles.title: iPhone 18 Pro : Apple aurait déjà réduit ses commandes de 20 %, les prix commencent-ils à peser ?
articles.text:
Les iPhone 18 Pro et Pro Max rencontreraient une demande moins importante que prévu, poussant Apple à réduire certaines commandes de composants. La hausse des prix pourrait commencer à peser sur les ventes des smartphones les plus haut de gamme du constructeur.
À peine trois semaines après leur commercialisation, les nouveaux iPhone d’Apple montreraient déjà quelques signes de faiblesse. Présentés le 9 septembre et disponibles depuis le 18, les iPhone 18 Pro et Pro Max arrivent dans un contexte de flambée du coût des composants, notamment des puces mémoire. Le constructeur a relevé ses tarifs dans de nombreux pays et les consommateurs ne semblent pas tous disposés à suivre. En coulisses, Apple aurait déjà commencé à ajuster ses commandes auprès de plusieurs fournisseurs.
Apple aurait réduit ses commandes d’iPhone 18 Pro de 15 à 20 %
Selon une enquête de Nikkei Asia publiée ce 9 octobre, Apple aurait demandé à certains fournisseurs de réduire la production de composants destinés aux iPhone 18 Pro et Pro Max. Plusieurs sources proches du dossier évoquent des commandes revues à la baisse depuis début septembre, avec une réduction comprise entre 15 et 20 % pour le seul mois d’octobre. Ces ajustements concerneraient les deux modèles premium, dont la demande serait inférieure aux prévisions initiales.
La situation ne toucherait toutefois pas l’ensemble de la chaîne de production de manière uniforme. Les fournisseurs disposent de délais de fabrication différents, ce qui explique que certains subissent immédiatement ces réductions tandis que d’autres pourraient être moins affectés. Impossible également de savoir si Apple procédera à de nouveaux ajustements à partir de novembre. Le constructeur n’a pas répondu aux sollicitations du quotidien économique japonais.
Un autre indicateur vient renforcer ces interrogations. Dans une note publiée cette semaine, les analystes d’UBS observent un raccourcissement des délais de livraison des iPhone 18 Pro dans plus de 30 marchés. Lorsque les stocks restent relativement stables, des délais qui diminuent peuvent traduire une demande moins soutenue. Ce constat ne suffit pas à mesurer les ventes réelles, mais il suggère que l’engouement habituel autour des nouveaux modèles pourrait être moins marqué cette année.
La hausse des prix et le nouveau calendrier d’Apple compliquent la donne
Le prix constitue l’une des principales explications avancées par les fournisseurs. En France, l’iPhone 18 Pro est commercialisé à partir de 1 479 €, tandis que le Pro Max démarre à 1 629 €, dans les deux cas avec 256 Go de stockage. Dans les deux cas, la facture a augmenté de 150 euros en un an. Une hausse qui intervient alors que les fabricants de smartphones doivent composer avec l’explosion du coût des puces mémoire, dans un contexte de forte demande pour les infrastructures dédiées à l’intelligence artificielle.
Apple n’est d’ailleurs pas seule à subir cette pression. Selon les prévisions d’IDC rapportées dans l’enquête, les livraisons mondiales de smartphones pourraient reculer de 16,7 % en 2026, tandis que leur prix de vente moyen aurait augmenté de 27,6 % sur un an. Un contexte particulièrement délicat pour les constructeurs, contraints de répercuter une partie de leurs coûts sur les consommateurs. Même Apple, dont les modèles premium constituent une part essentielle de l’activité, ne serait donc pas totalement à l'abri.
Mais les tarifs n’expliquent peut-être pas tout. Cette année, Apple a profondément modifié son calendrier en privilégiant les modèles haut de gamme à l’automne, tandis que l'iPhone 18 standard et le nouvel iPhone Air sont attendus au printemps 2027. Cette réorganisation pourrait mécaniquement réduire les volumes commandés sur la seconde moitié de l’année, sans nécessairement annoncer un recul comparable des ventes annuelles. Elle pourrait aussi permettre à Apple de préserver ses revenus grâce à des prix plus élevés, malgré des quantités écoulées moins importantes.
Ceci posé, une dernière question : quel sera l’accueil réservé à l'iPhone Duo ? Le premier smartphone pliant d'Apple, dont la commercialisation doit débuter le 23 octobre dans 70 pays et régions, affiche un prix de départ de 2 339 euros en France. Certains fournisseurs redoutent déjà qu’il rencontre les mêmes difficultés que les modèles Pro. Après avoir longtemps réussi à faire accepter des tarifs toujours plus élevés, Apple pourrait découvrir que même les amateurs de smartphones premium ont leurs limites. Et son premier iPhone pliant s’apprête justement à les mettre à l’épreuve.

articles.title: Diebe stehlen Anhänger mit Nvidia-Logo – und finden nur Sand
articles.text:
Nvidia-Logo lockt Diebe: Statt Chips erbeuten sie 18 Tonnen Sand
In den vergangenen Monaten gab es immer wieder kuriose Diebstahlsfälle im Tech-Bereich. So etwa ein gestohlenes Boot, das mithilfe eines Airtags wiedergefunden werden konnte. Oder aber auch Diebe in London, die Opfern ihre Samsung-Smartphones entwendeten und sie kurzerhand wieder zurückgaben. Ein neuer Fall rund um Nvidia reiht sich in diese ungewöhnlichen Vorfälle ein.
Ein Nvidia-Lkw voller Sand
Wie Wired berichtet, wurde eine der Führungskräfte bei PlusAI von einem Bekannten angeschrieben. Er gratulierte dem Chef hinter dem Unternehmen für selbstfahrende Lkw dazu, dass es seine Trucks schon in neue Regionen von Newark, Kalifornien, geschafft hätte. Der Bekannte hatte nämlich zwei der Anhänger des Unternehmens in der Nähe seines Arbeitsplatzes entdeckt. Doch tatsächlich sollten sich die Anhänger bei einem Warenhaus von PlusAI, etwa einen Kilometer entfernt, befinden.
Wie sich herausstellte, wurden die beiden Anhänger gestohlen. Die Diebe hatten dabei ihre eigenen Zugmaschinen genutzt, um die Anhänger einzuhaken und mit ihnen wegzufahren. Als Grund vermutet PlusAI, dass die Anhänger nicht nur das eigene Firmenlogo, sondern auch ein Nvidia-Logo zeigen. Offenbar hatten die Diebe gehofft, dass sich in den Anhängern Grafikkarten oder wertvolle Chips befinden könnten. Das Nvidia-Logo prangt allerdings „nur“ auf den Anhängern, weil PlusAI mit dem Hardware-Hersteller für die Umsetzung autonomer Lkw zusammenarbeitet.
Als sie die beiden Anhänger aufbrachen, wurden sie aber vermutlich schwer enttäuscht. Die Anhänger enthielten insgesamt rund 18.000 Kilogramm Sand. Das Unternehmen sagte dazu: „PlusAI nutzt simulierte Ladungen in den Anhängern, um Forschungs- und Entwicklungsaufgaben zu unterstützen.“ Beide Anhänger konnten mitsamt des Sandes wieder zu PlusAI zurückgebracht werden. Noch fehlt jede Spur von den Dieben.
Dieser Artikel wurde ursprünglich am 29.09.2026 veröffentlicht, interessiert jedoch immer noch sehr viele unserer Leser:innen. Deshalb haben wir ihn aktualisiert und hier nochmals zur Verfügung gestellt.

articles.title: World Mental Health Day: Rest in the Age of AI
articles.text:
World Mental Health Day: Rest in the Age of AI
On World Mental Health Day, Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar explains how AI, screen time and meditation affect creativity, mental wellbeing and human connection.
Some years ago, our attention span was 45 to 50 minutes. Today, it has reduced to just 47 seconds. There is a severe attention deficit today.
The increased use of screens has a big role to play in this. When we stare at a screen for too long, we blink less. That affects the freshness and creativity of our minds. People today have more experiences than their senses and minds can handle. They feel emotionally exhausted and inwardly lost.
The purpose of technology is to bring us comfort. If it becomes the cause of distress, its purpose is lost. Holding onto cell phones all day hurts the nervous system. But if you are free from stress, you will use technology for a good purpose.
AI can have three interpretations.
The first is the absence of intelligence. A lot of what comes on social media is fake and AI-driven. We have to move ahead in AI, but with awareness. We forget to recognise intelligence in nature, which is an absence of intelligence on our part.
The second is artificial intelligence. It can only reproduce what is already stored, not create something new. It challenges our intellect and creativity, and pushes us to do something original. Do not see the advent of AI as a hindrance. When calculators entered schools, teachers feared students would lose the ability to calculate. That did not happen.
The third meaning of AI is absolute intelligence. Wherever there is intelligence, there is consciousness. That one consciousness which envelops the whole universe is very orderly, and its intelligence is supreme. It connects us with a source deep within us which can bring out more creativity and enthusiasm. It can uplift the spirit around us and help us get over this terrible sense of loneliness.
The root cause of loneliness is stress and disconnectedness from ourselves. When we become centred, when we settle deeply within ourselves, we naturally discover that we are a source of joy.
Then, when people come together with a spirit of giving, serving, and contributing to each other's lives, genuine happiness follows. That is how loneliness is overcome, not by desperately searching for someone else, but by first becoming connected to ourselves.
No machine can replicate real human connection. We convey more through presence, feeling, and vibration than just words. Technology can help, but it cannot improve one’s vibrations.
If your vibrations are harmonious, positive, and joyful, everyone will love to be around you. Meditation makes your vibrations positive and makes you pleasant to be around.
Meditation is not a luxury, but a basic need today. I call it mental hygiene, just like brushing is dental hygiene. Meditation is not about doing something, but about being.
Like when you stop your car at the petrol pump, you turn it off so that you can fill it up. You can’t fill your car while driving. Once your car is full, you do not stay there; you drive. Similarly, we must pause to recharge ourselves, and then move back into activity with strength, clarity, and joy.
The best ideas and solutions arise amidst deep silence and meditation. When you are rattled, even good ideas fail. Focus and presence of mind can come from rest, not from effort or activity.
Technology must enable connection, wisdom, joy, and the journey within.
When we move from the absence of intelligence to absolute intelligence, artificial intelligence finds its right place.
By Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar

articles.title: NASA issues long-awaited call to industry for private space stations
articles.text:
NASA on Friday released a much-anticipated “request” to the US commercial space industry to develop private space stations that, as early as 2030, will succeed the International Space Station as a place for astronauts to live in low-Earth orbit.
In a cover letter accompanying the 360-page “request for proposals,” NASA stated its plan: “This will ensure NASA has a sustained human presence in LEO for crew members to perform science and exploration.” Several private companies that have worked for years on designing and developing such stations have been keen to learn exactly what capabilities NASA is seeking. These new documents finally provide some answers.
NASA’s solicitation can be found here. Industry responses are due back to NASA on December 8. NASA said it plans to select “two or more” contractors in this phase of the competition, and intends to make a final decision in April.
In LEO to stay
“We’ve made it clear that NASA will never give up its presence in low Earth orbit,” NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman said in a statement that accompanied the release of the new documents. “We will continue to need a place to conduct research, develop technologies, train crews, and prepare for missions to the Moon and Mars. Commercial space stations may provide that capability while creating new opportunities for American industry and allowing NASA to concentrate more of our resources on the near-impossible missions ahead.”
Bidders for this funding phase will certainly include Axiom Space, Voyager Space, and Vast Space. Blue Origin won an earlier round of funding from NASA, but questions remain about the company’s commitment to the program. SpaceX appears unlikely to bid, at least for now. Phase 1 winners will be guaranteed at least $100 million.

articles.title: Qué significa “Cuenta en revisión” en WhatsApp y cómo recuperar el acceso a todos los chats
articles.text:
Cada vez más usuarios de WhatsApp han reportado la aparición del mensaje “Cuenta en revisión”, un aviso que impide utilizar la aplicación mientras la plataforma analiza la actividad del perfil. Durante este proceso, la cuenta queda suspendida de forma temporal y el usuario no puede enviar ni recibir mensajes, realizar llamadas ni acceder a ninguna de las funciones del servicio.
Aunque el mensaje puede generar preocupación, no significa necesariamente que la cuenta haya sido bloqueada de forma definitiva. La revisión forma parte de los mecanismos de seguridad de WhatsApp para detectar posibles casos de spam, uso de aplicaciones no autorizadas o actividades que infrinjan las políticas de la plataforma. Una vez finalizado el análisis, la cuenta puede ser restablecida si no se detectan incumplimientos.
¿Por qué aparece el mensaje “Cuenta en revisión”?
WhatsApp utiliza sistemas automatizados para identificar comportamientos que puedan representar un riesgo para la seguridad de la plataforma o de otros usuarios.
Una de las causas más frecuentes es el uso de aplicaciones modificadas como WhatsApp Plus, GB WhatsApp u otras versiones no oficiales. Estas aplicaciones alteran el funcionamiento original del servicio y violan las condiciones de uso establecidas por Meta.
Otro motivo habitual es el envío masivo de mensajes en un corto periodo, especialmente cuando se trata de personas que no tienen registrado el número del remitente. Este comportamiento puede ser interpretado por los sistemas de detección como una posible campaña de spam.
Asimismo, ciertas actividades inusuales o cambios recientes en los algoritmos de seguridad también pueden activar revisiones preventivas, incluso cuando posteriormente se determine que la cuenta no incurrió en ninguna infracción.
Qué ocurre mientras la cuenta está bajo revisión
Cuando una cuenta entra en revisión, WhatsApp suspende temporalmente todas sus funciones.
Durante ese tiempo no es posible enviar ni recibir mensajes, realizar llamadas de voz o video, compartir archivos ni acceder con normalidad a los chats. La cuenta permanece congelada mientras Meta analiza si hubo alguna vulneración de las normas del servicio.
El tiempo de revisión puede variar dependiendo del caso, por lo que la compañía recomienda esperar a que concluya el proceso antes de intentar realizar cualquier otra acción.
Cómo recuperar el acceso a la cuenta
Si aparece el mensaje “Cuenta en revisión”, los especialistas recomiendan no entrar en pánico y seguir una serie de medidas para facilitar el restablecimiento del acceso.
La primera consiste en mantener instalada la versión oficial y actualizada de WhatsApp, descargada únicamente desde Google Play Store o App Store. Esto reduce la posibilidad de que el sistema detecte software no autorizado.
También es importante esperar a que finalice el proceso de verificación sin intentar crear nuevas cuentas para eludir la revisión, ya que esa práctica podría generar nuevas restricciones.
En caso de utilizar aplicaciones modificadas, la recomendación es desinstalarlas inmediatamente y migrar a la versión oficial de WhatsApp, ya que estas herramientas representan uno de los principales motivos de suspensión.
WhatsApp explica por qué realiza estas revisiones
Ante los reportes de usuarios afectados, WhatsApp explicó que estas revisiones forman parte de su estrategia para combatir el spam y el uso de aplicaciones falsas.
En declaraciones al portal especializado TechCrunch, un portavoz de la compañía aseguró que los sistemas de detección buscan proteger a la comunidad frente a abusos y actividades maliciosas.
La empresa también reconoció que, como ocurre con cualquier sistema automatizado, pueden producirse errores durante el proceso de identificación.
“Trabajamos constantemente para prevenir el abuso de nuestro servicio y bloquear cuentas con el fin de proteger a los demás usuarios. A veces cometemos errores y, si es así, intentamos solucionarlo lo antes posible para que la gente pueda volver a chatear”, señaló el vocero.
Cómo evitar que tu cuenta vuelva a ser revisada
Para reducir el riesgo de que WhatsApp vuelva a suspender temporalmente una cuenta, la principal recomendación es utilizar únicamente la aplicación oficial y respetar las políticas de uso de la plataforma.
También conviene evitar el envío masivo de mensajes a contactos desconocidos, no utilizar herramientas automatizadas para distribuir contenido y mantener siempre actualizada la aplicación.
Aunque el mensaje “Cuenta en revisión” puede resultar inquietante, en la mayoría de los casos se trata de una medida temporal destinada a verificar la seguridad de la cuenta. Si el análisis no detecta infracciones, el acceso suele

articles.title: Sony's VR patents are reportedly going to Meta, which isn't a good sign for PSVR 3
articles.text:
TL;DR: In a move that suggests Sony is scaling back its ambitions in the virtual, augmented, and mixed reality space, the company has reportedly sold a massive portfolio of VR-, AR-, and XR-related patents to Meta. The deal also suggests that the rumored successor to PSVR 2 is unlikely to see the light of day.
Records from US and international patent offices reveal that Meta has purchased 419 patents covering head-mounted displays, XR glasses, and VR tracking technologies developed by Sony between 2010 and 2022. The deal suggests an abrupt change of heart at Sony, whose senior VP, Eric Lempel, claimed in 2024 that VR was an important sector for the company.
According to ZDNet Korea, Meta and Sony signed a Confirmatory Assignment agreement in December 2025, formalizing Sony's plans to transfer its VR patents to Meta. The portfolio includes 180 US patents, 43 of which were transferred between June and September 2026. The remaining 239 patents are reportedly registered in Japan, China, South Korea, Europe, and other regions.
Sony's decision to offload its VR patents suggests that the rumored PlayStation VR 3 could be dead in the water. Moreover, online rumors indicate that Sony's retreat from the VR space could have direct implications for PSVR 2 owners. While existing headsets should remain fully functional, users are unlikely to see any new first-party VR titles for the PS5 or PS5 Pro in the future.
Despite the disappointing news about PSVR 3, VR gaming enthusiasts have something to cheer about: the recent release of a free third-party VR mod for EA's 2016 FPS classic, Titanfall 2. Developed by Jordan "CircuitLord" Juarez, the mod brings the entire game into VR through a simple 350KB download available from the developer's GitHub repository.
The mod adds full VR support for the Titanfall 2 campaign, including stereoscopic rendering, full-body inverse kinematics, manual reloading, Titan controls, and redesigned interactions tailored specifically for VR. It works with any PC VR headset that supports OpenXR. The mod currently supports only the single-player campaign, but the developer says he is working on multiplayer modes using private VR servers.
Released in late September, the mod has already received widespread praise, with The Verge calling it "one of the best VR games ever." The experience is particularly accessible because Titanfall 2 is currently on sale for just $5 and can run on relatively modest GPUs, such as the GTX 1080. The developer confirms that the mod works with all three PC versions of Titanfall 2.

articles.title: Hoy No Circula sabatino: qué autos pueden circular y cuáles descansan el 10 de octubre
articles.text:
Este fin de semana entra de nuevo en funcionamiento la normativa del Hoy No Circula sabatino, un marco regulatorio mediante el cual la Secretaría de Medio Ambiente de la Ciudad de México (SEDEMA) restringe el tráfico para controlar los índices de polución en la Zona Metropolitana del Valle de México.
Es decir, todo conductor que quiera salir de casa deberá cerciorarse minuciosamente del último dígito de su matrícula y del engomado de verificación antes de encender el motor. Es importante remarcar que estas limitaciones no se aplican exclusivamente en las 16 alcaldías de la CDMX, sino que influyen también en diversos municipios periféricos del Estado de México. El programa opera del mismo modo en:
- Atizapán de Zaragoza
- Coacalco de Berriozábal
- Cuautitlán
- Cuautitlán Izcalli
- Chalco
- Chicoloapan
- Chimalhuacán
- Ecatepec de Morelos
- Huixquilucan
- Ixtapaluca
- La Paz
- Naucalpan de Juárez
- Nezahualcóyotl
- Nicolás Romero
- Tecámac
- Tlalnepantla de Baz
- Tultitlán
- Valle de Chalco
Asimismo, toma en consideración que si tu recorrido contempla atravesar cualquiera de estos puntos geográficos, las reglas del Hoy No Circula sabatino resultarán obligatorias.
A qué autos y placas afecta el Hoy No Circula sabatino
El objetivo central de este esquema es aminorar la cantidad de vehículos en circulación para mitigar las emisiones contaminantes; sin embargo, las jornadas sabatinas se rigen mediante pautas específicas que se acoplan al calendario habitual de lunes a viernes. La necesidad de suspender la circulación no afecta de igual manera a todos los conductores cada fin de semana: la calcomanía de verificación, la terminación numérica de la placa y si la fecha entra en la categoría de semana par o impar definirán quién debe mantener la unidad aparcada y quién cuenta con libre tránsito.
Conviene puntualizar que el Hoy No Circula sabatino no permanece activo a lo largo de las 24 horas consecutivas del día. Las restricciones abarcan desde las 05:00 a las 22:00 horas. Es decir, de noche no se impone ningún freno a la movilidad, salvo que las autoridades decreten una fase de contingencia ambiental u otra medida extraordinaria que establezca límites adicionales.
En el caso de este sábado 10 de octubre de 2026, como estamos ante el segundo sábado del mes, las restricciones dicen que se tendrán que quedar en casa los coches provistos con holograma 1 y placas terminadas en número par.
En cambio, los coches identificados con holograma 0 y 00 mantienen su autorización para circular libremente dentro de las reglas del Hoy No Circula sabatino. Por su parte, los automóviles con holograma 2 carecen de permiso para circular cualquier sábado del año.
Además de las restricciones expuestas, cabe recordar que existe un grupo de vehículos exentos que pueden rodar sin verse condicionados por estos límites. En esta lista se incluyen:
- Vehículos eléctricos, a gas natural o con tecnología híbrida
- Unidades registradas con placas de personas con discapacidad
- Todos los destinados a servicios de transporte público urbano (incluyendo servicios funerarios)
- Los dedicados al transporte escolar o de pasajeros
- Aquellos asignados a seguridad pública y/o protección civil
En caso de incumplir con el Hoy No Circula se castigará con una multa que oscila entre 20 y 30 veces el valor de la Unidad de Medida y Actualización (UMA), una cifra que representa aproximadamente desde 1,924.40 pesos en su escalón más bajo hasta alcanzar los 2,886.60 pesos en el límite superior. Además, el conductor se arriesga a que el automóvil sea trasladado al depósito de vehículos.

Today, Logitech debuted Rally Speaker 2 Pro and Rally Speaker 2 Max, audio systems engineered to bring highly-precise sound targeting to extra-large conference rooms and training environments. Rally Speaker 2 Pro and Max house Logitech's proprietary Sound Shape technology and mark Logitech's entry into the Pro AV market.
Acoustics are particularly tricky in high-value spaces such as executive boardrooms and divisible rooms. Ceiling speakers—the usual fix—are costly to install, involve complex wiring, and result in voices coming from unnatural directions while sound waves crash into each other, creating echo and cognitive fatigue. Rally Speaker 2 Pro and Max—speakers at the front of the room only—present a less expensive, simpler way to guarantee uniform sound coverage throughout these spaces.
Karthik Rajagopal, Head of VC Engineering at Logitech"Today, we cross the boundary from science fiction into a bold new era of human interaction," "We've replaced the brute-force approach of cranking up room volume with wave-field physics—essentially steering sound waves through open air with surgical precision."
Here is how the technology in Rally Speakers Pro and Max works:
- 32 tiny speakers work together: Instead of using two or three standard speakers, the Rally 2 Speaker Pro features a matrix array of 32 micro-drivers in a single front-mounted soundbar. Rally 2 Speaker Max further expands room coverage with 64 drivers.
- The "flashlight" effect: Standard speakers scatter sound in every direction like an old lantern, bouncing off walls and ceilings. Rally Speaker 2 Pro behaves like a hyper-focused spotlight, shooting precise beams of sound straight where they are needed without bouncing off the walls.
- Wave control: Rally Speaker 2 Pro uses principles of sound physics that cause waves to line up to boost volume, while simultaneously intentionally canceling each other out in directions that sound shouldn't go.
- Even volume everywhere: In a 12-meter (approx. 40-foot) room, standard speakers lose significant volume from front to back. Rally Speaker 2 Pro only loses about the sound level of a human breath, making the volume feel identical whether you sit in the front row or the back row.
International Boardrooms of the Future: A Peek at What's Possible
In an early preview, Logitech showed an exciting multilingual concept in development. Because it targets sound so precisely, a Rally Speaker 2 Max mounted at the front can aim two entirely different audio feeds at opposite sides of the room at the same time—allowing, for example, English speakers on the left and French speakers on the right to hear their respective languages without hearing the other side, without requiring separate speakers distributed across each area. Logitech is working closely with partners to integrate Interpreter in Microsoft Teams meetings and Voice Translator in Zoom Meetings with this technology.
"The international boardroom of the future isn't about finding a single universal dialect—it's about translation coexisting in the same acoustic space. Sound Shape unlocks big potential for cross-border diplomacy, global M&A negotiations, and multi-regional training environments," Rajagopal added.
Availability
Rally Speaker 2 Pro and Rally Speaker 2 Max can be demoed at Logitech Experience Center in Silicon Valley. Commercial availability is slated for summer 2027.

articles.title: Long live the mechanical keyboard | TechCrunch
articles.text:
For a writer, the mechanical keyboard is a beautiful thing. It’s certainly not necessary for everyone, but a well-designed mechanical keyboard can turn a tedious day of typing into an aesthetically pleasing experience.
Given that most of my days involve sitting at a desk for hours, having a keyboard that I enjoy using is a necessity. I first got a mechanical keyboard about two years ago — the Keychron K2 — and I’ve never looked back.
Keychron is one of the most prominent brands within the mechanical keyboard industry, having made a name for itself after initially launching via Kickstarter back in 2017. The company has since produced dozens of different keyboards (as well as keypads) and a variety of mouse models.
Unlike other electronics, there isn’t a whole lot to owning a mechanical keyboard. The simplicity is part of the appeal. You unbox them, set them up (the K2 comes with little tilt legs that give you a slightly better angle from which to type), and plug them in.
From here, you have a couple of different options. The K2 comes with a simple USB cable, but there’s also an option for Bluetooth connection. If you value a clean, minimalist workspace, Bluetooth is probably the way to go.
While I am loyal to my older Keychron K2, there are a few upgraded and newer versions to consider. Keychron has released a variety of new models over the past two years, with a broad range of features and price tags.
In many cases, the form factor is the draw. One of the more interesting releases, called the Keychron K8 HE Wireless Magnetic Switch Custom Keyboard, comes with an all-wood body and is equipped with an LED backlight. That one is substantially more expensive at around $200. The K2, meanwhile, costs $60. But if you’re into the look, maybe it’s worth it.
If you’re a gamer, there’s also Keychron’s C0 HE One-Handed 8K Keyboard, which is a keypad built for convenience and speed and has an industrial aesthetic to it. However, interested gamers will have to wait — as it’s currently sold out.
The company has also updated its K, Q, and V series keyboards, with many of those ranging in price from $100 to $200, depending on the features and model.
One of the appealing elements of owning a mechanical keyboard is the versatility. You can swap out the key caps for a wide variety of others (indeed, there’s a whole submarket devoted to this) or make your own custom caps (I’ve never gone that overboard).
There is also the sound, of course. Some people balk at the accentuated noise of loudly clacking keys, but I’m a fan. In fact, the sound is one of the key selling points for a lot of consumers. The distinct auditory experience produced by said keyboards has even made its way into ASMR videos.
For me, the Keychron’s biggest selling point is its retro form factor. I get really nostalgic for old school electronics, and Keychron scratches this itch pretty well. It’s a beautiful-looking device, which brings to mind a different era of computing, when the style was more workman-like, less minimalist.
As far as home office purchases go, you could do a lot worse than to pick yourself up a piece of hardware that makes your desk look like it just time-traveled from the 1990s.

articles.title: Crazed modder straps 360mm AIO radiator to laptop, cuts temps to below 40 degrees — performance gains an average of 14% in games and benchmarks
articles.text:
Crazed modder straps 360mm AIO radiator to laptop, cuts temps to below 40 degrees — performance gains an average of 14% in games and benchmarks
His daughter is going to love this beast
YouTube hardcore PC modder TrashBench attached waterblocks, a water pump, and a 360mm radiator to a Metabox laptop with an Nvidia GTX 1060 and Intel Core i7-8750H. This Frankenstein’s monster of a laptop dropped a whole 60℃ on both the CPU and GPU during benchmarks and stress tests and gained an average of 14% after overclocking.
TrashBench, a YouTuber popular for extreme PC modifications involving various watercooling solutions, decided to “fix” laptop cooling by taking a cut-up 360mm AIO from another project and plans to use it on the Metabox P950EP. Metabox is an Australian brand of laptops rebranded from Clevo, an ODM brand from Taiwan that often gets rebranded in various countries. TrashBench intends to use this laptop for his daughter to play Fortnite on.
The modder intended to use the stock AIO pump along with a second waterblock for the CPU, but after testing whether it would be strong enough to push through a second block, TrashBench realized he would need a bigger pump. He also needed to use another waterblock since the new pump was a standalone one, unlike the waterblock and pump combo on an AIO.
The waterblocks were mounted via a 3D-printed holder, then screwed down to the existing holes previously used for the stock heatpipe and blower cooler. More 3D-printed mounts were used to hold the radiator behind the screen of the laptop, but couldn’t be screwed in because the space between the screen and shell was too small. TrashBench reluctantly used Loctite 2-part epoxy to attach the radiator mount onto the laptop.
That’s not all epoxy was used for, as he didn’t forget about the RAM and VRMs. A heatsink was attached to them, with thermal pads bringing the RAM level with the VRMs to use a single heatsink for each cluster. The VRMs had a dab of thermal paste and a spot of epoxy to keep the heatsink in place, making the modification permanent.
After fully assembling everything and attaching the blocks, pump, and radiator with flexible clear tubes using screw hose clamps, TrashBench tested it for leaks. “I think we’re good,” he says, just before a few bubbles passed by.
The laptop uses 19v, while the pump and fans use 12v, so a DC-DC step-down converter was soldered to the original blower fan’s electrical contacts. Unfortunately, the power source powers on as soon as the laptop is turned on, with no way to make them only turn on under load. So the modder used a toggle switch mounted to a 3D-printed plate, screwed onto the bottom shell that had a large gaping hole cut out of it to accommodate the pump and waterblocks.
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
To allow the laptop to stand, a 3D-printed riser was screwed to the bottom and is the final touch to the build. As ridiculous as it looks, it impresses with its performance, averaging 60℃ below stock, with the CPU and GPU staying well below 40℃ under full load.
Conservative but clear performance gains were seen after benchmarks, but with the amount of temperature overhead, TrashBench decided to see how much more he could get by overclocking, and it was worth it, as Forza Horizon 5 went from 75 FPS to 77, and then to 83 FPS after overclocking.

articles.title: Apple’s 512GB local AI beast nears, but M5 Max gets $200 price drop
articles.text:
As Apple readies its 512GB M5 Ultra Mac Studio for local AI, the M5 Max workstation drops by $200
This is one for serious pros
Apple's most extreme Mac Studio, an M5 Ultra with 512GB of memory aimed at running huge AI models locally, is due to ship in late October. And that might be one reason why I'm seeing the - ahem - "cheaper" M5 Max model dropping $200 in price right now.
• Best for: Creative professionals and AI developers who want Mac Studio power without paying M5 Ultra prices.
• The deal: The Apple Mac Studio (M5 Max, 36GB, 512GB) is $2299 (was $2499) at B&H Photo.
• Why it matters: We're expecting to see more of the 512GB M5 Ultra at Apple's upcoming event next week. And I reckon we could be looking at prices starting well above $10,000. That makes the M5 Max Mac Studio the machine most people can realistically buy, and it's now cheaper as the new flagship approaches.
Today's best Mac Studio (M5 Max) deal
This is the base M5 Max configuration, with an 18-core CPU, 32-core GPU and 16-core Neural Engine. It has four Thunderbolt 5 ports, 10Gb Ethernet, HDMI 2.1, an SD card slot and Wi-Fi 7, and B&H notes that supply at this price is limited.
Why we recommend it
Our roundup of M5 Ultra Mac Studio reviews revealed the Ultra's real strength is local AI, while its multi-core lead over the M5 Max is only about 26% and single-core performance is about the same, which is why the roundup points most creative users to the M5 Max. The M5 Max is the best-suited model for most professionals, as 36GB of memory fits many workflows. However, 1TB is a more practical starting point for storage than 512GB, and that's currently discounted to $2579 (was $2799) on the site.
Price Context & Historical Value
At $2,299, this is $200 (8%) off Apple's $2,499 starting price. Now, Mac Studio discounts may improve in the months after launch, especially around Black Friday, so this may not be the lowest price it reaches - but it's the lowest I've seen right now. As with previous Macs, you can't upgrade the memory in this model later, so make sure 36GB is enough before you buy.
Should you buy it?
✅ Buy the Apple Mac Studio (M5 Max) if...
You want Mac Studio performance for creative work or local AI at around $2,300, and you don't need the M5 Ultra's 512GB memory ceiling.
❌ Skip the Apple Mac Studio (M5 Max) if...
You need the 512GB M5 Ultra for large local AI models, or you want more than 512GB of storage without an external drive.
